text:
Sam: FYI — AcmeBank asked for three artifacts before POC: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted ok), an ISO/27001 certificate or formal statement of compliance, and a signed pen-test attestation letter they can include in procurement. POC kickoff is targeted for next Tue. Can we commit to what and by when? Also they asked whether dedicated pricing includes any extra compliance docs.

Anya: We can provide a redacted SOC2 report + controls mapping. We don't have an ISO/27001 cert at company level to hand over, but we can provide an ISO readiness/controls matrix + statement.

Priya: Confirming — security can produce: (1) redacted SOC2 Type II report, (2) evidence mapping CSV, (3) network/segmentation diagram for Dedicated if requested, and (4) a pen-test attestation letter. Pen-test attestation needs legal + security sign-off. ETA: ~48 business hours to assemble redacted report + mapping if we prioritize.

Mel: @Sam @Priya I can sign the pen-test attestation, but I need the SOW (or a written description of the engagement), the recipient name/email, and the exact wording the customer needs. We typically avoid sharing scoping details of third-party pentests; signature/attestation is OK if the content is limited.

Sam: Noted. Acme specifically requested a signed letter that says a recent external penetration test was performed and no high-severity open findings affecting hosted infra. They didn't ask for the full report.

Anya: On the dedicated pricing question — Dedicated includes a standard network review and a one-time engineering setup. If they want additional assurance artifacts (e.g., extended retention of logs, extra network segmentation work), that can be quoted separately. I'll pull numbers.

AuditBot: Ticket CPL-4829 created: package SOC2 (redacted), control mapping, sample pen-test attestation template. Owner: Priya. SLA: 48h.

Priya: Quick checklist I'm going to follow — will post artifacts to secure DLP folder and share presigned link.```

Required for customer deliverable:
- redacted SOC2 Type II (remove customer-identifying details)
- controls mapping (csv)
- pen-test attestation (signed pdf)
- network diagram (if Dedicated requested)
- SOW / recipient details for signature
```

Mel: Sounds good. Once you upload drafts @Priya, I will review and sign. We need to confirm: (a) that redaction level is acceptable to Acme, (b) that we keep no extra vulnerability detail in the attestation.

Sam: I'll ask Acme to send the SOW + recipient email and to confirm redaction level. I scheduled a quick sync with them tomorrow 10:00am PT to close this out. Thanks everyone :pray:

Anya: I'll follow up on pricing line items and post a short note in this thread after the call.

Priya: Started packaging — will update ticket CPL-4829 with links.

Mel: Approved in principle; will sign once I have recipient and final draft.

Sam: Great, will update thread after call.
